payload.posture: Read Acts 2:22–36 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states at Pentecost Peter moves from Jesus’ deeds and death to God’s raising, David’s psalm, apostolic witness, exaltation, Spirit, and lordship. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
